project: Northsignal Labs MSP Security Reporting Template Pack
purpose: Machine-readable approval preflight for the local public-URL cutover workflow. This file does not approve publication; it records whether reviewer-supplied fields are complete enough to replace the northsignal-labs.local sitemap/robots placeholder.

required_fields.approved_channel: GitHub Pages under Northsignal-Labs organization repository msp-security-reporting-template-pack
required_fields.account_repository_metadata_constraints: No personal identity, private contact details, personal account links, invented founder claims, customer claims, certifications, partnerships, testimonials, revenue claims, payment links, analytics, forms, sensitive-data collection, paid domain, paid hosting, ads, subscriptions, marketplace fee, paid add-ons, purchases, or spend in public profile, repository metadata, release text, issue templates, or commit metadata.

cutover_allowed_only_when: all required text fields are non-empty and contain no private personal identity details
public_base_url uses HTTPS and is not the placeholder host
spend_confirmation is true, confirming no paid domain, hosting, ads, subscription, marketplace fee, paid add-on, or purchase is required
financial_workflow_confirmation is true, confirming no payout, tax/KYC, checkout, sponsorship, active monetization link, paid listing, or other financial workflow is required
data_collection_confirmation is true, confirming no analytics script, cookie banner, contact form, newsletter signup, private inbox, or lead capture workflow is required
claims_identity_approval is true, confirming Northsignal Labs is described only as a small independent automation lab with no fake founder or unsupported claims
current_hold_reason: Concrete reviewer-supplied public channel fields have been applied locally. Run tools/validate_approval_handoff.py, then tools/perform_public_url_cutover.py as a dry run before any --apply cutover. This file still does not authorize account creation, upload, public posting, analytics/forms, payment/KYC/quote/invoice/sales workflows, or spend.
